purpose: Evaluator-only, source-derived numeric targets with explicit units, operations and scopes. Original dataset annotations remain untouched. These are not ID-wide correctness overrides.

Four unit mismatches are handled in tatdqa_scoring_normalizations.json; nine accepted annotation/ambiguity cases are adjudicated here. These post hoc corrections apply identically to every model; all accepted claims have not been independently source-audited. Original gold remains available in the literal and benchmark views, and the corrected target applies identically to all models. The Qwen3 30B four-case review on 2026-10-16 additionally corrects the VMware basic-versus-diluted gold row and records the unresolved department scope of the Everbridge percentage-change question. These targets apply to all models and verdicts.

records.question: What is the total value of outstanding options and warrants under the Amended and Restated 2010 Share Incentive Plan?
records.reason: The 2010 Share Incentive Plan's 19468188 securities comprise 19464437 restricted share units and 3751 stock options. Footnote 3 explicitly excludes restricted stock units from the weighted-average exercise price because they have no exercise price. Multiplying the entire plan population by 48.105 incorrectly includes RSUs; the source-supported exercise value uses only the 3751 options. The displayed exercise price is USD per share (not USD thousands). A half-unit in its last printed decimal is 0.0005 USD per share, so the propagated source-precision tolerance is 3751 * 0.0005 = 1.8755 USD; the shared scoring policy remains max(this absolute floor, 1% of the target), as for other reviewed targets. This target describes aggregate exercise value, not an option fair-value valuation.

records.question: What is the change in the % of revenue?
records.reason: The page contains three identically named % of revenue rows, and the standalone question does not name a department. Sales and marketing changes from 45% to 47% (+2 percentage points), research and development from 21% to 28% (+7 points), and general and administrative from 22% to 21% (-1 point). The inference input supplies the whole page without question history or a selected-table annotation. Gold 7 implicitly selects R&D, while its thousand scale is invalid for this percentage difference. Each department supplies a separate source-supported target; this is an ambiguity adjudication, not proof that the dataset intended sales and marketing. Explicit percentage-point units and the legacy percent representation of a difference in revenue shares are both recorded. These are absolute changes in shares, not relative percentage growth rates. A one-point absolute floor follows the whole-percent displayed operands; retain the shared relative and sign policies and do not override candidate correctness unconditionally.
